response.justification: While the candidate has extensive and impressive experience in full-stack software engineering, web development, and application architecture, they completely lack the specialized hardware and performance engineering skills required for this role. There is no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, deep-learning workload optimization, hardware-software co-design, or GPU/accelerator architecture experience, which are the core responsibilities of this Principal Performance Architect position.
strengths: Meets the baseline requirement of a Bachelor's degree in CS with over 8 years of technical experience.
Extensive background in full-stack software development, system architecture, and tool creation.
Some exposure to low-level and high-performance programming using C/C++ and DLang.
concerns: No demonstrated experience with SoC and IP modeling or hardware-software co-design.
Lacks expertise in deep-learning workload analysis and AI accelerator performance optimization.
No background in GPU, SIMD, or MIMD architecture.
